A refined adult anime face drawn to her own FACE line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

In this cut her species shows in the outfit itself: its recognisable colours, shapes and parts. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

SCENE (chosen):

Weather / season: a snowy day — snow falls or lies outside, with frost on any window.

Outfit: a daring adult costume version of Makuhita itself — black, yellow colours; its black marking, broken trees, black boxing gloves, round hands rebuilt as costume pieces (ears or headband, hood, tail, gloves, fabric prints), never painted on her own skin, cut as a high-cut bodysuit with sheer thigh-high tights; styled with a silk ribbon tied in her hair

Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.
LEGS: weight on one leg, the other knee softly bent.
GAZE: she looks toward the right of the frame.
EXPRESSION: raised brows, widened eyes with visible upper white, mouth open in a small round shape. Show it mildly, only with her brows, eyelids and mouth corners; her face shape and features stay exactly as in the attached image.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; nothing slipped off; chest and pelvis covered

The costume must read at first glance as that creature's look, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit; she is a real woman in a costume — never the creature itself, its face on her face, fur or scales on her skin, a logo or readable text.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus; other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No Pokémon, animals or other creatures, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions — about 7.5 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. No extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.
